description.en-US: Montgomery Carmichael's English (John Murray, 1901) of the allegory of the Blessed Francis and his companions seeking and wedding Lady Poverty, written in 1227 after Francis's death: the twenty-five chapters of the translation with Carmichael's notes, the Scripture references of the margin placed in parentheses. Carmichael's chapters differ from the thirty-two of the Latin book, so it is a separate book of the same work.
description.pt-BR: A tradução inglesa de Montgomery Carmichael (1901) da alegoria do bem-aventurado Francisco e seus companheiros em busca da Senhora Pobreza: os vinte e cinco capítulos, com as notas do tradutor.

sources.edition: The Lady Poverty: A XIII. Century Allegory, translated and edited by Montgomery Carmichael (London: John Murray, 1901); Project Gutenberg e-text 66025.
sources.description: The translation only, chapters I-XXV, with Carmichael's footnotes; the introduction, Father Cuthbert's chapter on evangelical poverty and the appendices are not imported.
sources.tierEvidence: Published in 1901, before 1931: public domain in the US.
